sources.quote: HD 153950 is a star in the southern constellation of Scorpius, positioned about 1.2° to the west of Eta Scorpii.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.4 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,926 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
